clause: Warp family: warp, puppet warp, perspective warp, liquify [STU-RAS-029]

scope.summary: Implement the mesh/warp reshaping primitives on layers, selections, and placed-asset containers: Warp (grid/handle mesh warp with warp presets and custom control-point deformation, including bezier mesh warp); Puppet warp (pin-and-deform mesh with density and expansion); Perspective warp (multi-plane perspective reshaping/correction, single- and dual-plane); Liquify (localized mesh push-forward/left, twirl, pinch, punch, turbulence, mesh-clone, reconstruct brushes, with freeze/thaw masking). Mesh math runs in studio-engine.
acceptance_criteria: warp/puppet-warp/perspective-warp/liquify with presets + custom control points
liquify brushes + freeze/thaw masking + reconstruct proven
proof_targets: mesh warp + liquify freeze/thaw runtime + snapshot
expected_tests: live: apply a mesh warp preset and a custom control-point deformation; puppet-warp pins deform a shape; liquify push-forward brush with a frozen region leaves the frozen area unchanged
test: reconstruct brush restores warped mesh toward original

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Warp, puppet warp & liquify

risk_if_missed: No warp/liquify; organic reshaping and perspective correction absent.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
